QUOTE: | `schema`, index newer than server | Server predates the index | Restart the MCP client. A rebuild cannot clear it. | ... | `code` | Running process predates the source tree | Restart the MCP client. A rebuild is unsafe and cannot fix it. | ... "The caller's job is to read which axis is stale, because only one of them is fixed by a rebuild."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says data is cleared by a refresh and code by a client restart, and that only one axis is fixed by a rebuild. It never says this is why one flag would not have been enough, but the different remedies per axis are stated.
